# Yourbody.fyi

> A no-frills log for your lifts and meals. Free forever, with coach mode built in. Your data stays yours.

## What It Is
- You know your workout. We just help you track it.
- Fast workout and nutrition logging for personal lifters and coaches.
- Simple, honest tracking designed around how you actually lift and eat.
- No credit card required. Free tier includes workout & meal tracking.

## Main Features
- No frills: No programs to buy, no streaks, no feed. Log sets and meals in seconds and get back to training.
- Free forever: Workout and meal tracking, quick log and coach mode for up to 3 athletes cost nothing, now and later. Paid plans only add AI meal logging and bigger coach rosters (coming soon).
- Coach mode: Coach up to 3 athletes free, 10 on Coach, 25 on Coach Pro (coming soon). See their workouts and macros in one place, and give them AI meal logging on a paid coach plan (coming soon).
- Your body, your data: No ads. Your workouts and meals are never sold. Export everything any time.
- Offline tracking: Log workouts and quick meal logs; they save on your phone and sync when you're back online.

## Who It Is For
- Personal lifters: Full offline workout and meal tracking for personal lifters.
- Everyday lifters (coming soon): For everyday lifters who want continuous daily AI meal logging.
- Trainers (coming soon): For trainers managing up to 10 athletes with client AI benefits.
- Active coaching practices (coming soon): For active coaching practices managing up to 25 athletes.
- Athletes: Athletes can track workouts and meals completely free.

## Pricing
- Free to track. Pay only for AI.
- Base features are free for everyone. Paid tiers add continuous AI meal logging and expanded coach rosters. Paid plans will become active when billing launches.
- Free forever: $0. Full offline workout and meal tracking for personal lifters. Includes 14-day AI meal logging trial (30/day) and coach mode for up to 3 athletes.
- Personal (coming soon): $2/month or $10/year. For everyday lifters who want continuous daily AI meal logging.
- Coach (coming soon): $5/month or $40/year. For trainers managing up to 10 athletes with client AI benefits.
- Coach Pro (coming soon): $10/month or $80/year. For active coaching practices managing up to 25 athletes.

## Privacy & Data
- No ads. Your workouts and meals are never sold. Export everything any time.
- No advertising or tracking cookies: We do not use third-party advertising cookies, behavioural profiling trackers, or cross-site tracking scripts.
- Device-local storage: We utilize browser storage directly on your device to cache your recent workouts, exercises, and pending sync items.
- Account deletion: You can delete your account at any time. When an account is deleted, your personal profile, workout logs, nutrition logs, and routine templates are permanently removed from active databases.
- Data exports available: A complete export in JSON or CSV format can be downloaded at any time directly in Settings under "Data Extract".
